clue.text: Prosecuted corrupt abbey and its leader during way-out cat-call in the 20 23

definitions.note: the definition is the famous stage direction found in that play, so 'in the play' points to a line of it

indicators.note: something corrupt has been spoilt and twisted out of shape, so the word it qualifies is rearranged
what happens during something sits inside its span, so the preceding letters go inside the call

blocks.note: a way out of a building
the sound a contented cat makes
took to court
taken as written
the first letter of abbey

explanation.surface: A monk is hauled into court after heckling with a cat-call at a performance of a Shakespeare play.
explanation.walkthrough: 20 23 is The Winter's Tale, whose most famous stage direction sends Antigonus off chased by a bear. The hyphens mislead: 'way-out' is one piece and 'cat-call' another, with the rest wrapped inside the call.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare wrote this exact instruction into Act III of The Winter's Tale, the most celebrated stage direction in English drama.

clue.text: Antipasto (mince - I made it!) - not for Bond!

explanation.definitionFit: An emancipationist campaigns for freeing slaves, so such a person is against bondage.

explanation.definitionFit: Something ideal is perfect, flawless in every respect, as complete as can be.

explanation.definitionFit: Perdita is the lost daughter of Leontes and Hermione, the heroine of Shakespeare's The Winter's Tale.

the speaker, I

explanation.definitionFit: Ultimate means final, coming at the very end of a series.

clue.text: What sort of gun is the Lee-Enfield?

definitions.text: What sort of gun is the Lee-Enfield?

explanation.walkthrough: The Lee-Enfield was the standard British rifle of both World Wars, single-barrelled; its name, though, is a hyphenated pair like a posh surname.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun with two barrels side by side, and also a hyphenated surname such as Lee-Enfield.

explanation.definitionFit: In bridge, a contract played without a trump suit outranks all suit contracts of the same level.

ninety in Roman numerals

explanation.definitionFit: The song praises Silvia as surpassing every mortal thing, which is what being outstanding and supreme means.

clue.text: Sometime lonely, now more like a squash

clue.text: Tell and sell

clue.text: Fast entertainment - deep's the solution?
